title: El viejo de la esquina
goal: Let an old man tell you what this street used to be
culture: He has all afternoon and the only thing being asked of you is that you stay for it. There is nothing to win here and no transaction — this is the mission that teaches you that listening is a thing you do in Spanish too.

beats.es: ¿Usted vive aquí ahora? Esta calle antes era otra cosa.
beats.objective: Ask what it was like before
beats.good: Antes does the work of a whole tense here. Ask it once and you have twenty minutes of answer.

beats.es: Uy. En aquel tiempo esto era todo de tierra. No pasaba un carro.
beats.en: Back then there were no cars?
ok: en aquel tiempo no habia carros
beats.good: En aquel tiempo is his phrase, not yours yet. Using it back tells him you are following, and he will keep going.

beats.es: Ni uno. Y la gente se sentaba afuera. Ahora ya no es igual.
beats.say: Ya no es igual, dice usted.
beats.en: It’s not the same any more, you say.
ok: ya no es igual dice usted
beats.good: Agreeing with the complaint is the correct move and it is free. He is not asking you to fix anything.

beats.es: Usted no vio eso. Usted no lo vio.
beats.good: Usted no vio eso from him, yo no vi eso from you. He is not scoring a point — he is telling you that you had to be there, and agreeing is the whole of your part.
